One of these three boxes is hiding a GIANT diamond! Can you guess which one before the reveal? Comment your answer below! 👇

scenes.narration: One of these boxes is hiding a GIANT diamond — but which one?!
Is it the RED box, the BLUE box, or the YELLOW box? Pick your answer RIGHT NOW!
scenes.visual_prompt: red blue yellow gift boxes row

scenes.narration: The clock is ticking… three… two… ONE!
Let's open the RED box first… oh no, it's just a rubber chicken! Bawk bawk!
Okay okay, what about the YELLOW box? You open it and… it's a smelly old sock! Ewwww!
That means… the BLUE box has the diamond! Let's open it… OH WOW — there it is! Shining and sparkling — HUGE!
Did you get it right? Drop a blue heart in the comments! And come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it gets way harder!
